title: Walls folding away
description: Walls and tall furniture used to fold down to a skirting while they hid Gerard. That is off for now, to try the house without it; in development the picker's Lugares tab has 'Paredes que se pliegan' to turn it back on (remembered in this browser).

steps.caption: Off (now the default): in the narrow room behind the wall, the wall stays standing and hides Gerard
Development picker · Lugares: 'Paredes que se pliegan', Sí or No
Sí: the wall in front of Gerard folds down to its skirting, as before
Back to No: the wall rises again
